summary: First test pass for the Anoncoin Sniper Telegram bot MVP. All 8 requested checks passed: /api/health returns paper mode + trading_enabled, /api/metrics returns full JSON schema with tokens_scanned>0 (8 after ~60s), no raw secrets (Telegram/Anoncoin/Solscan) found in supervisor logs, structured log messages (bot_started, anoncoin_discovery_unavailable_using_mock_feed indirectly via mock_feed activity) render intact, SQLite DB at /app/backend/data/bot.db contains all 9 expected tables with 8 rows in tokens, dashboard renders correctly (dark terminal theme, all 8 data-testid cards populated, PAPER + ENABLED shown), Telegram getMe returns ok:true username=anoncoinsniper_bot, pytest suite 25/25 pass, .gitignore excludes .env and data/*.db.

minor.issue: error_count=14-16 accumulates over time; confirmed via logs these are the expected Solscan 401 'upgrade api key' failures from /token/meta and /token/holders (documented as graceful-degradation, not a real bug). Consider splitting into 'expected_degradations' vs 'unexpected_errors' counters so operators can distinguish real problems.

issues: Clean dark terminal theme renders well; no contrast/alignment issues. Minor nit: no last-updated timestamp shown to the user so it's not obvious the 5s poll is happening (all cards do update on refresh though).

critical_code_review_comments: Redaction filter working correctly - verified 0 matches for raw TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / ANONCOIN_API_KEY / SOLSCAN_API_KEY values across both backend.out.log and backend.err.log.
.gitignore correctly excludes .env, data/*.db and journals; secrets & DB won't be committed.
Consider adding a lightweight /api/health deep-check that reports scanner-last-tick timestamp so operators can detect a stalled background scanner without SSHing to logs.
Metrics endpoint mixes 'expected degradation' errors (Solscan 401 for un-entitled endpoints) with real errors in a single error_count -- worth splitting for clarity.
test_credentials: N/A - Telegram-only control surface, no web auth. Bot token & API keys read from /app/backend/.env (masked in this report).
seed_data_creation: None - the background scanner + mock_feed fallback organically populates the tokens table (8 rows observed after ~60s uptime).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs via supervisor (uvicorn on 8001), Telegram polling is embedded in FastAPI lifespan. Anoncoin discovery endpoints are 'Coming Soon' upstream, so scanner uses app/scanners/mock_feed.py -- source=mock_simulated tags and [SIMULATED] Telegram prefix are intentional. Solscan token/meta + token/holders returning 401 is expected (plan limitation) and gracefully logged. Live execution path is a documented no-op fail-safe. Do NOT try to automate Telegram commands (no user session). Focus any future retests on: rule-editing flows if E1 adds a web UI, and confirming error_count breakdown if error taxonomy is added.
